request: Adopt ideas from t3dotgg/tstack skills/file-pr at 6efae364201abc9d9f07443e9caa461f42e51090: weak and strong title and opening examples, impact rather than mechanism in titles, a problem-first opening from the requester's perspective, title convention from merged PR titles and base history, and a REST fallback when GraphQL is exhausted. Decline the model and harness attribution footer.

size.method: Whitespace-separated words across SKILL.md and all references.

growth_reasons: Title impact rule, measurement condition and weak/strong pairs for title and opening: user request (ideas 1-3).
Title convention reads before a title and titles in the merged-PR query: user request (idea 4); reviewers found title-only requests skipped them.
REST lookup in the exact-PR step and REST write, comment, read-back, fork and draft-wait routes: user request (idea 5); reviewers verified that an unqualified REST head filter returns unrelated PRs.
Repository-required AI disclosure exception: keeps the declined footer from overriding repository rules.

review.dispositions: All findings adopted in 8b307ea, including evaluation. maintainer_can_modify for forks adopted to match gh pr create's default of allowing maintainer edits.

evaluation.design: Cases 14 (regression), 15 and 16 (new). Executors: Claude Code 2.1.291 with claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh (Read/Glob/Grep only, skills disabled, strict empty MCP) and Codex CLI 0.160.1 with gpt-6.1-sol at xhigh (read-only sandbox, ephemeral). Each read only a neutrally named staged copy of the arm's runtime files; Codex traces show reads only under pkg/. One trial per case, host and arm. Graded by the coordinator (claude-opus-5-5), not blind.

case_matrix.claude_base: 8/8; title names mechanism and outcome, no figure

evaluation.limits: Case 16 does not discriminate: both hosts already chose an owner-qualified paginated REST route without the new text, so it guards against regression rather than proving gain. Case 15's baseline already opened problem-first; the final arm moved both hosts' titles to the measured impact. Single trials support only these cases. Other cases (1-13) were not rerun; their reads of title or REST text can change only the title wording and the GraphQL-exhausted branch, which they do not exercise.
